next_real_sources: Obtain publisher full Bae 2015 Methods and GenBank accession table if available; verify accession against NCBI record including material/voucher.
Do not treat 2020 MN871982 chloroplast as 2015 schantarense ITS.
Recover nuclear phylogenomic tip or sample for down-facing C. schantarense in a locus-compatible dataset before patristic trait-memory calculations.
reference_notices: Original Bae 2015 abstract confirms Korean rDNA experiment but does NOT provide an independently checked GenBank record identifier.
Primary Xu et al 2020 article gives species C. shansiense, accession MN871982 and voucher WNU52012.
A secondary 2022 Chinese article prints C. schantarense next to MN871982; species identity in that secondary citation is inconsistent with original.
POWO accepts shansiense and schantarense separately; a white forma synonym is not a distinct sampled genome or re-evolution event.
